metaDesc: AXEM-SX 1.0.1 release notes — slim ISO, full curated desktop in one zypper command, Wayland-only, Boh-IO AI console, Cockpit administration on openSUSE Leap 16.0.
s1p: AXEM-SX 1.0.1 is the latest release of the 1.0 stable line — a sovereignty-oriented workstation built on openSUSE Leap 16.0. The ISO ships slim by design, and one zypper command unlocks the full curated desktop.
s1card1Desc: Test the Boot-to-Studio workflow and Cockpit-based management.
s1card2Desc: Enterprise-grade core with some Beta edges from upstream.
s1card3Desc: Specifically seeking reports on local AI and Wayland on NVIDIA hardware.
firstCmdIntro: The ISO is intentionally slim — fast to download, fast to boot. After a quick zypper refresh, a single command unlocks the full curated experience: LibreOffice, Inkscape, VLC, multimedia codecs, Flatpak with Flathub, and the guided third-party app installer.
firstCmdGoFurther: Want more? Run axem-sx-install-thirdparty for a guided menu of Spotify, Discord, VS Code (Flathub) and Anti-Gravity (OBS). For full multimedia codec coverage (H.265, AAC encode), run sudo /usr/bin/axem-sx-codecs-upgrade-to-packman.
profilesIntro: AXEM-SX provides distinct system profiles, each designed as a complete and coherent working environment. Only one profile is intended to be active at a time.
profilesLightDesc: A minimal, fast, accessible Wayland environment designed for essential computing and lower-resource systems.
profilesProDesc: A complete, capable Wayland environment with extended tools and features for advanced users and professional workflows.
profilesGoldDesc: A polished GNOME Wayland experience for users who prefer the GNOME paradigm — refined, focused, distinct.
profilesWhyTitle: Why one profile at a time
profilesNote: Advanced users may choose to combine components manually, but AXEM-SX does not rely on mixed-profile configurations by default.
glanceIntro: A glimpse of the AXEM-SX environment — desktops, menus, and applications curated for sustained, serious work.
glance1Caption: Pro Edition Desktop · KDE Plasma Wayland
glance2Caption: AXEM-SX Top Menu — curated workshop launcher
glance3Caption: AXEM-SX Control Hub — unified system administration
glance4Caption: Control Hub Logs — readable, contextual journal view
glanceHint: Click any thumbnail to view full size
s2p: AXEM-SX 1.0.1 is a pure Wayland system. We have aligned fully with the upstream decision to remove legacy display servers.
s2li1: No fallback X11 session at the login screen.
s2li2: Older applications run transparently via XWayland.
s2li3: Open kernel driver and user-space drivers install automatically on supported GPUs.
s2tip: If you experience black screens during installation, boot with the nomodeset kernel option.
s3p: AXEM-SX introduces Boh-IO — Bridge Our Humanities with Input & Output. A specialized console with a Bash terminal on the left and a local AI Sidecar on the right.
s3li1: axem-sx/boh-io via Ollama. No data leaves your machine. History exists only in RAM.
s3li2: The axem-console package is in both ISOs. The BOH IO model (~2 GB) is downloaded separately via: ollama pull axem-sx/boh-io
s3li3: Active — see the Features page for the full step-by-step setup guide.
s4p: Unlike most distributions that have dropped YaST entirely in favor of generic web tools, AXEM-SX preserves and curates YaST through the AXEM-SX Control Hub — giving you the power of a proven administration layer with a refined, workstation-focused interface alongside Cockpit.
s4li2: Storage · Networking · Logs — curated for workstation tasks.
s4known: A gray line visual glitch may appear in the storage menu when activating certain disks. This is cosmetic and does not affect data.
s5p: These are currently manual steps in base Leap 16.0 — AXEM-SX applies them for you out of the box.
s5li1: Docker and KVM (libvirt) work side-by-side immediately. Firewall backend forced to iptables to prevent the known upstream conflict.
s5li2: PipeWire is the default sound server — PulseAudio fully replaced.
s5li3: NetworkManager only — the legacy wicked tool suite is removed.
s6li1: Cannot log in as root via SSH using a password. SSH key required.
s6li2: Strict security policy enforced — AppArmor is not the default.
s6li3: All remote services are disabled by default.
s7li3: RAM disk (tmpfs) — cleared on every reboot.
s7warn: Running AXEM-SX in a Virtual Machine on an older host will cause a kernel crash. Set the VM CPU type to host-passthrough or host-model.
liveCredBody: Both the Light and Pro ISOs boot into a live session. No installation is required to test.
liveCredTip: Log in with user axem and password axem to access the full live desktop.
s8known1: Installer Network Config: Complex network setups (bonding) are limited during install. Use DHCP for installation, configure via Cockpit after.
s8known2: Zypper Repository: A bad repository source may be added after install. If zypper complains, remove it with zypper rr 1.
s8known3: Pro Desktop Icons: Trash and Home icons may appear on the desktop after first login (Plasma containment / pcmanfm-qt artifact). Right-click and remove them — AXEM Pro routes Trash through the top panel by design.
